steps.title: Analyze app switching and screen lock audio persistence requirements
steps.description: Reviewed web view lifecycle and HTML5 video event listeners to prevent playback interruptions during backgrounding and lock screen states.

steps.title: Enhance Foreground Audio Service with Audio Focus Management
steps.description: Implemented explicit audio focus request handling in BackgroundAudioService for seamless background audio execution.

steps.title: Inject robust Page Visibility API overrides
steps.description: Overrode document.hidden, document.visibilityState, and EventTarget addEventListener to block auto-pause scripts when switching apps.

steps.title: Implement background video auto-resume handler
steps.description: Added delayed JS handler in onPause and onStop activity callbacks to keep audio streaming continuously when screen turns off.

steps.title: Configure MediaSession transport controls for lock screen
steps.description: Synchronized notification action buttons and lock screen controls with media state.

steps.title: Manage CPU WakeLocks for lock screen continuity
steps.description: Secured partial CPU wake lock to preserve web socket streaming when mobile screen is locked.

steps.title: Inject periodic HTML5 video status bridge
steps.description: Maintained continuous JavaScript bridge checking video element state and overriding system pause calls.

steps.title: Configure WebSettings for low-latency background audio
steps.description: Optimized DOM storage, cookie management, and JS execution for continuous background audio.

steps.title: Validate audio focus ducking and interruption handling
steps.description: Handled audio focus transitions smoothly when other apps request audio focus.
